meta.title: Overwatch 2 to CS2 Sensitivity Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert Overwatch 2 sensitivity to CS2. Same cm/360 across games.
sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
cm360Desc: Distance your mouse must travel for one full 360° rotation
steps_overwatch2-to-cs2-sensitivity_1Des: Input your OW2 sensitivity and FOV. The converter scales it appropriately for CS2's slower, more tactical gameplay.
steps_overwatch2-to-cs2-sensitivity_2Des: The CS2 sensitivity appears instantly. FOV scaling is applied so your mouse movement distance for a 360° turn is preserved.
steps_overwatch2-to-cs2-sensitivity_3Des: Apply in CS2. Expect the sensitivity to feel lower — CS2 emphasizes crosshair placement and angle holding rather than tracking.
